qualificationBasis.request: Maintainer requested completion of Linux MiniMax Code admission on 2026-10-18.

limitations: Actual mcode execution is on Ubuntu 24.04.5 GNU x86_64. Three-distribution Server smoke does not claim mcode execution on each distribution; no Linux ARM64 or musl qualification.
Deterministic local model-service batches use the real official CLI and Core but are protocol/effect evidence, not independent real-provider generation proof.

Native /compact management is exercised by a separate native ACP client; no product manual-compaction button is added. Official 0.6.12 manual-command cancellation did not settle within 240 seconds; that attempted case is invalidated. Actual product Core Run cancellation during automatic compaction and exact successor recovery are separately verified.

The overflow case injects one typed 400 and forwards the retry to the real provider. Native commits once with an unchanged request body. This does not prove adaptation to a persistently smaller undocumented provider window or natural exhaustion of gpt-6.1-sol capacity.
Partial native Usage can omit early, short, cancelled or late observations. Root-native metadata does not provide a full bill; absent reasoning and reliable cost remain unknown.

Native default permission rules can allow simple printf writes; deny qualification therefore uses a real operation that actually asks. Plan mode plus explicit bypass permits writes. No additionalDirectories or OS-level sandbox guarantee is claimed.
Questionnaires follow the maintainer-accepted dismiss/no-answer policy; Fast remains excluded. macOS arm64 and Windows status are not promoted; existing Intel qualification is independent.

Older capability/CLI evidence includes token-count relay errors followed by the native fallback; all stated generation/tool effects passed. The relay token-count route was corrected for subsequent clean basic and compaction runs.

Failed setup and harness-assumption attempts are retained privately. The automatic-compaction batch failed only an extra body-shrinking assertion after its six individual cases had passed; separate manual retry/cold evidence closes the required flow.
Credentials, raw prompts, private paths, native Session/Run identities, transcript and full tool output are excluded.
